g.text: Bhoonaksha runtime — how the live app works
Static MapLibre map on Vercel. No bundler, no framework. No owner / khata / ULPIN / FMB feed.
RoR / owners: link only if a
state publishes a URL. Else empty.
Honesty: no closed gov data, no ULPIN, no FMB, no invented owners. RoR is a door — never a scrape.
